nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Kids Gentle Sunscreen Face and Body Lotion SPF 50

avis.titre: Great sport sunscreen for the whole family
avis.texte: I live at 6,000' + elevation, sun exposure is serious. The texture is great for a water resistant spf and provides a wide spectrum coverage not possible with mineral spf. We apply to toddler and adults faces and body for preschool, hikes, and beach.

I have used this sunscreen on my daughter—who has sensitive skin and eczema—for over two years, and it has always protected her very well; she has never gotten sunburned. It is important to reapply every two hours when they are more exposed to the sun.
I love this brand but this sunscreen did not work for my son. I applied the cream multiple times but he still got burned and now he has sun spots. For the price, I expected better.

I'm in the middle of The Animal Kingdom at Disney world really upset righting this! This sunscreen just ruined my whole day!!!! I used this sunscreen at my kid, 10 min in the park she rubbed her eye and it started watering and got really irritated! And then my hanger boy started with the same Simpsons! I'm really frustrated since I've always used this brand. This is all very upsetting to have a dream trip ruined by something that was supposed to protect!!!! I've never had this issue with another kids brand!

Went on evenly and offered great protection to all of the littles on our beach outings. From Erie to Key West, not one of them was irritated or sunburnt. They didn't complain about it feeling "icky" either.

I used this this past summer on my daughter and it worked perfectly. She didn't burn at all and we were either at the pool or beach all summer! It was perfect. I usually only reapplied once on days where we were at the beach or pool all day.

avis.titre: Great for my sensitive skin boys!
avis.texte: This sunscreen applied very smoothly, was not tacky, sticky, nor irritated their skin. Two of my boys are prone to eczema, and get bumps after using many sunscreens and getting sweaty. I was very impressed, and would personally purchase! This item was sent to me complimentary by Influenster in exchange for an honest review. This is not a paid review
It gave my daughter a huge rash on her face the 2nd day I applied this on her, had to use a different product as this one seemed to irritate her skin. Wish it would have worked for me.
This was amazing for my son and his sensitive skin. It is great with how quickly it absorbed into skin vs a leaving some white chalky mineral look.
La Roche-Posay Anthelios sunscreen is a great product for kids. It doesn't leave you feeling all greasy. It goes on smooth and does it's job. I recommend this product to anyone that has kids.
It looks horrible on my skin. I have used it on different occasions and it always happens the same. Don't waste your money.

La Roche- Posay kids gentle lotion SPF 50 sunscreen is a must use for kids. Not only did it protect my kids skin, there was no residue at all. Goes on easy and last long. Great for all outdoor in the sun activities.

avis.titre: Review on La Roche Posay Anthelios Kids
avis.texte: This sunscreen works well, except for a few things. Causes tremendous eye sting, smells like motor oil when first applied and comes right off in water even when applied 30 min before. My daughter was still getting sun burned/extremely tanned even after putting a generous layer of this on her face and body and waiting at least 30 min before jumping in the pool, and she only spent 45 min in pool for her swimming class.

avis.titre: Don't hesitate to purchase this sunscreen!
avis.texte: We bought this in France 🇫🇷 and was sad when when it ran out. We were so happy to find it available in the U.S. I absolutely love this sunscreen for my child! Runs on clear & doesn't leave a white residue. It's also reef-safe which is an added bonus for ocean swims. We've tried all the brands of kids sunscreens (including pricier ones) and this is my child's preferred one & doesn't protest when I put it on him.
Easy to apply lasted while the kids swam was not messy and has a great scent we love and will keep using for every summer great protection from summer sun!!
Works great for kids in the water, easy to apply and long lasting. Love all the La Roche-Posay sunscreens. Great for sensitive kid skin in the sun

By far the best sunscreen out there! I used it daily for a 3 week trip throughout Italy during a heatwave and didn't get burnt despite me being fair as can be and outside the majority of the day. Will always buy again!!!
It is liquid and easy to apply, my daughter has eczema and it did not cause any reaction but she used it on her face and her eyes began to water so I recommend being careful in the facial area.

avis.titre: Prevents sun damage and keeps skin clear
avis.texte: Excellent for sensitive skin. My daughter and I have been getting an allergic rash on our face with other sunblocks. This is the only sunblock that doesn't cause a rash and does a great job preventing sun damage. We are grateful to La Roche for making such a great product.
Complimentary by influenster this sunscreen was great to use on my kids. It lasted for several hours and my kids skin was soft and gentle. I recommend buying this sunscreen for kids.

I received this complimentary product from Influenster in exchange for honest review. This is a great sunscreen but I didn't see much difference between this and other off brand kids sunscreens. We still used it but will stick to other sunscreens. Thank you for the opportunity, Influenster!

I purchased this product because the ingredients list showed that it did not include Avobenzone, Octisalate, and Octocrylene. However, when I received the product, this sunscreen does include these ingredients which are NOT reef safe and is banned from parts of Hawaii. Will be returning. Please update the ingredients to include everything.

Love this sunscreen for my kids! It does take a minute to get it all rubbed in but other than that I use it every day on them! We're always outside in the sun soaking it up so I'm glad I received this!

First of all I love La Roche-Posay products! This sunscreen is the absolute best! It is not too thick or too thin. It rubs in perfectly and has a very soft scent. Honestly it's everything I would want in a sunscreen for my kids! Plus it's for sensitive skin. It's a little pricey but worth it!

I love the lotion sunblock, I feel like I know it's on and my kids are protected! White color of lotion doesn't really absorb but that's okay, but as a mom spray sunscreen has cut the time of application in half. Still great product!! Would buy again and use
I was excited to receive this but after reading the ingredients on the label, I couldn't use it. The packaging is nice, but too many chemicals for our family.
We used this all weekend at the lake! It works wonderful! My kids stayed sunburn free!! It rubs in well and doesn't feel to greasy! I will definitely get some more!

avis.titre: Goes on smooth w/o the greasey feeling from other
avis.texte: My grandson is a ginger and has fair skin and this keeps him from getting burned. It works great. I'll definitley buy and even recommend others use this product
Used this on our Destin beach trip. None of the girls got sunburned so definitelythink this is worth trying because one is super fair complection and she didnt even turn pink
Works very well felt good not oily on my child's skin properly fallowed on application and went well. Was slightly sunburned but not like she would before ￼

avis.titre: Worked great for both of my kids!
avis.texte: I have a one year old and also a 5 year old. We live in Florida so sunscreen is a must. We have been using this sunscreen for our pool days and it's worked great! No skin irritation on either kid and most importantly, no sun burn!
Love La Roche-posay and I trust this brand completely, I use this for my toddler and I've also been using it for myself lol it's nice and not sticky, a really pleasant texture.
Got this in the mail as a free sample from Influenster. Used it on my children in Florida and it works pretty well. Smells good and rubs on easy. Definitely recommend

This is absolutely a new summer staple in my household of 5 kids! The application is so easy as there is no white residue that needs to get rubbed in over and over. It absorbs quickly and no white shows. There is a very faint fragrance. This sunscreen offered tons of perfection while at the beach the other day. Allowed for a nice tan and zero sunburn!

avis.titre: Great addition for your beach tote or other outdoo
avis.texte: Our family is very active and go out doing fun adventures all the time. I have started grabbing this amazing La Roche-Posay Anthelios Kids Gentle sunscreen lotion for my family. My daughters have slightly sensitive skin and break out easily. This feels not too oily and blends in nicely. Faint scent is not overwhelming like some other brands which is good. I like scents but not my daughters. A must have now!
Living in Florida this is necessary we spent 12 hrs at the beach and my niece with sensitive skin applied this and never burned great product and did what it said

My kiddo is so super sensitive to the sun so I'm constantly trying new sunblocks to meet her precious needs, this worked fantastically for our first day in the sun this summer and didn't irritate her skin at all!
I loved this sunscreen! We used it before going kayaking and he did not have any redness and it didn't make him greasy feeling at all. Will definitely start pitching this brand
My kids all have sensitive skin and this sunscreen worked wonders. No rash and they had no sunburn even in the Florida beach sun. I will definitely recommend and purchase again.
Absolutely recommend this sunscreen for all moms who have kids! It's easy to put on and doesn't leave a white cast. Doesn't smell like chemicals and is gentle on the skin!
I received this sunscreen from Influenster, and it is wonderful! All of my children have sensitive skin, and this sunscreen does not irritate them. I definitely recommend this product!

Used it on my daughter last week when it was super nice and it kept her from getting sunburnt. It's not as heavy or goopy as the other sunscreens i use so I'll definitely be using this All summer long.

avis.titre: great for my child's sensitive skin!
avis.texte: my child has eczema and very sensitive skin on top of that.. this product didn't disturb his skin at all. it also protected him very well from the sun while outside playing.
I love how it's not like other sunscreens last like it says my kids approve my kids like it. Definitely recommend this and will keep purchasing this product.
Finally had nice weather and got to give it a try. It goes on nice and smooth, provides excellent coverage and doesn't leave the white residue. This is definitely the new sunscreen for my boys!

avis.titre: The best sunscreen for my child
avis.texte: This is the best I've ever tried for my daughter. Usually the cheaper brands have a pale ghostly finish to their sunscreen but this product went on like face lotion. My daughter has very sensitive skin and had no issues with this on her eczema prone skin. She never got any color or sunburn to her skin while wearing. A definite must try for moms!

I couldn't be happier with how this unscented sunscreen applied. It absorbed right in and left a powdery dry finish to my skin. No white cast or residue on my face. And the best part was it didn't cause a rash in my daughters sensitive skin. Very happy with this one
My 5 year old and 3 year old loved it. Goes on easy and everything not sticky at all or have that film that most do. Finally having nice weather here this will be amazing to have thanks
This lotion glides on, protects the skin and does not have a strong sunscreen odor. It did a great job protecting my 9 year old. I've even used it on my face. No sunburn! I recommend it!

I loved this this past week since it started warming up. Put some on my daughter and I actually use it daily in my face. Works wonders just like the adult face version. Love that it's not as white as other sunscreens. Speeds well and even. I'd recommend.
This sunscreen seemed to work good for my kids. My son also has sensitive skin and was able to use it. I would definitely purchase this product and recommend it to friends

avis.titre: Perfect for my wild 3 year old
avis.texte: Got to try this out for a fun filled zoo day on a super sunny Wednesday. My son didn't seem to mind it at all and usually puts up a fuss. It worked great and didn't need constant application. Definitely worth it as a little goes a long way as well!

avis.titre: Absorbs super easy, great for skin with eczema!
avis.texte: My daughter has sever eczema on her body, the worst of it being on the legs. Almost everything burns her skin when applying. However, this applies beautifully and doesn't cause burning or irritation to her already sensitive skin. As you can see in the photos it didn't cause her eczema to turn ready or itchy even hours after applying it. This is a keeper!
Great for kids! Gentle. Applies well. Stays on. Smells nice as a sensitive formula. Would for sure buy again. My kids didn't complain about it like they do most lotion types.

I absolutely love this product as my son has zero pigment in his skin. Usually we have to use very thick sunscreen so he doesnt burn but this is the opposite of thick and does a fantastic job at protecting while not being greasy. So my husband has no issues putting it on him because of texture issues.

I was waiting for a summer day to try it out but unfortunately here has been crazy (cold, rainy and windy anything but sunny) either way I may say the texture feels light and it doesn't leave a white coat on your skin.

This is the best sunscreen ever. It has the silkiest feel and goes on so smoothly. It feels so great that my daughter thinks it's just for fun. I love that it feels nourishing and we know it's good for us at the same time.

I used this on my son who has very sensitive skin. It worked great on him and was easy to apply and spread on the skin. I would definitely use this on my son all summer long to give him that uv protection!
I had used some kind of sunscreen for my kids but I feel this one is really good for my kids. Kids's skin didn't turn red under the sun. They feel comfortable.

I love a good sunscreen that doesn't leave you looking super ghostly or is to oily. This us an awesome product for my little one. & I love that it's a sunscreen and a moisturizer! Excited to continue using this as the summer months creep in on us!

I don't use a lot of sunscreen on my kids but I'm always happy to try something new. There's no white cast, it spreads easily, and is non-greasy. Looking forward to giving it more of a test as it warms up and we spend more time outside.

I received the La Roche- Posay Anthelios Kids Gentle Lotion SPF 50 Sunscreen complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review and my daughter liked it more than I expected. My six-year-old has extremely sensitive, fair skin so I always like to lather her with sunscreen before she steps outside. When she was younger she didn't mind but in the last year, she has seemed to begin dreading this and trying to get out of the task. So when we applied this and she said she didn't mind this one, I was shocked! She stated that she was glad that this one didn't smell bad (fragrance-free) and didn't feel greasy. I noticed that it also applied extremely easily, was very lightweight, and did not leave a white cast at all. Not to mention this is doing a great job keeping her from getting a sunburn every time we use it and lasts relatively long between applications.

The La Roche-posay Anthelios Kids Gentle Lotion works well, its not as oily as your normal sunscreen and does not have the fragence as normal suncreens do. We will continue to use this for our children.
Works great. Feels nice on the skin, non greasy. It leaves skin feeling soft and clean unlike most others. No white cast. Smooths on and rubs in easily. Definitely worth the price
Thick in texture without the white residue that sunscreen lotion could have behind! This came at the perfect time since Spring has sprung and we're outdoors more. Will purchase in the future!

￼ This sunscreen runs, super smoothly over the skin, it dries clear and non-greasy￼. It feels very soft on the skin. What ￼I love best about these sunscreen is that it does not have the traditional smell ￼ that other sunscreens have.

#Received product complimentary from Influenster. I have sensitive pale skin and this sunscreen does a great job at preventing me from getting sunburn. I love that it's water resistant and it does not burn your eyes.It does not smell bad either.

avis.titre: I like how it doesn't have a strong smell and leav
avis.texte: Used it on my kids this weekend at the river and love it it leaves no white cast and it has no strong smell which is good for my daughter she has autism and strong smells are a no

The La Roche-Posay sunscreen exceeded my expectations. It applies super easy and quickly. It sinks into the skin super quickly and doesn't leave a heavy feeling. It doesn't have the normal lotion feel to it either. I highly recommend this product. Only problem is that it is on the pricey side.
This product has been awesome for my kiddos. It goes on well and has no smell. It does great protecting from the sun with minimal reapplications.

Lightweight, easy to apply and does not leave a white residue. It has a nice, subtle smell that fades quickly. My children are very fair skinned so I usually prefer mineral sunscreens but this one protected them just the same!

I hadn't reviewed this product until now because we've been inside but now that baseball season has started it's been perfect for protecting my little one while running around the baseball field! so thank you for allowing us to review this project!!

I tried this on myself before I put it on my babies and it definitely passed the test! It's not too thick and spreads easily with no white cast, but still has that classic sunblock smell which I don't think kids really care about (just putting it out there for adults with sensitive skin that would use this). Overall would recommend!
My kids love this sunscreen, it dry fast not felling greasy after use. That is how my kids always want to put on every time they do outside. Overall, it is good sunscreen for this price.

The sunscreen worked really well on my children and myself. We applied in the morning, played the entire day, and were protected from the sun. The formula is light and absorbs readily, leaving only a faint residual layer on the skin - it is among one of the more comfortable sunscreens I've tried. The formula did not run on my kids once absorbed, but this sunscreen isn't suitable for intense outdoor workouts. (I experienced mild eye irritation at 15 min into my sprint workout - not enough to stop though). Really pleased and I'll repurchase for the kids.

I really like how this is SPF 50, paraban free and with UVA/UVB protection plus antioxidants. It says fragrance free, but it does have a slight scent to it. It's what sunscreen usually smells like, but very faint. The sunscreen is a silky white and it comes in a squeezy tube. The amount that comes out when you squeeze it is well controlled, so you won't accidentally squeeze out too much. When spreading it on my sons skin, it seemed a little thick at first, but I was pleasantly surprised with how far it all actually spread. A little goes a long way it seems, but of course with your littles, there can never be too much. When it dries down, it does not have a tacky feel. It feels smooth with a little bit of resistance when gently swiping your hand across the skins surface. It does not leave a residue or look crusty. It soaks into the skin perfectly. There is a slight sheen to the skin after applied, but not too shiny. It states that this will remain waterproof for up to 80 minutes. My son and I put that to the test during one of our frw sunny days and playing at the beach in the water. I applied some to his face, arms and legs. It is definitely water proof. I made sure it withstood the towel test (getting wet, drying off, getting wet, drying off etc) and every time it was the same as the first, so that is very good. I have not tested the entire 80 minutes, as it is the "false spring" here on the west coast.. meaning once it gets sunny and nice and you're preparing for spring act

This seems to protect the skin well from the sun, as well is quick absorbing. The weather limited my ability to truly try this product during the time I was testing it. However, it seemed to work well and I will be trying it when the weather permits.

I have not had weather yet that I needed use this with yet so I can not comment on how it works or how it rubs in or if my children had a reaction to it. Our weather has been cold her, with I would of had more time with this one to give a better review
Living near Lake Erie, sometimes finding shade isn't always the easiest. We loved how easily this sunscreen rubbed in and the protect it gave was just what our day needed. Would recommend.
I like that this is SPF 50 and that it's good for sensitive skin, it goes on nice and not oily. I don't care for the smell. It's not strong but not pleasant. Works as it says but not for us.
Love this brand and so excited that I got this for my son!! We're going to Disney world next month so it's definitely going to come in handy being in the sun
Even through a full day of baseball, this covered very well and lasted all day. My son, who is very sensitive to products, did not break out or seem to be bothered at all. Another plus!

As a parent of two boys with sensitive skin (and some complexion issues myself), I was thrilled to receive La Roche-Posay's Anthelios Kids Gentle Lotion SPF 50 Sunscreen to test for my two cents. First of all, I love this brand and have been a fan for years now. I trust them. I trust their products won't make me break out. I trust what they claim is in the tube is really there and the ingredients are quality. I trust what they create for my kids is safe. In other words, I knew the chances were very slim this wasn't going to be a great product. TLDR; Just buy it. You're going to like it. Still there? Here's why. - Pediatrician AND dermatologist approved. - Non comedogenic and allergy tested. - Powerful antioxidant protection. It's like the entire medical community got in on this. Anthelios Kids Gentle Lotion SPF 50 Sunscreen has been perfect for my boys! They highly recommend (at least the one who can talk does). Thanks, La-Roche Posay!
I like that it absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a white cast. It doesn't feel heavy or sticky. I can use it for our fun water adventures and sports

avis.titre: Not a fan of chemical sunscreen…
avis.texte: Did this sunscreen work? Yes! Works very well and blends good on my darker skinned baby. Things I did not like was the fact that this is a chemical sunscreen (I try to stick to mineral sunscreens), it was thick and quite gooey, and has a somewhat strong sunscreen smell. But overall this sunscreen worked perfectly and was water resistant. If you don't mind chemicals on the skin then you should def try this for your kiddos. It does have a pretty high price point but I would rather pay more for better than not protect my child's skin for less money.
Goes on easy and absorbs into the skin doesn't leave residue or anything behind and lasts along time kept my daughter safe and protected from the sun without burning.
Smooth, not sticky, no obnoxious smell. It's very thin but it's not like other sunscreens that I have to reapply bc it's too thin. Great product! Really love it

I really was impressed with this stuff. One of my kiddos has extremely sensitive skin and eczema and this stuff gave him no reactions! It applies thickly, spreads fast and easily and leaves no white cast. It doesn't sting their eyes or cake. It is pricier than other sunscreens advertised for babies and children, but this stuff is more effective in my opinion because it didn't melt or wash off from water or sweat. Of course like any sunscreen, it should be reapplied in a couple of hours.

Both of my children have sensitive skin and sunscreen tends to burn when applied. I've been using La Roche-Posay Anthelios Kids Gentle on them for a month now and they haven't complained one time! Also it does a fantastic job of keeping them from burning. I love the texture of this and it's easy to rub in without leaving a major white cast.
Unlike other sunscreens I have used for my daughter, this one is a bit more runny which I feel absorbed better into the skin. The smell is the same as other sunscreens

avis.titre: Works but could have a better scent
avis.texte: La Roche-Posay is a great brand and I am not surprised this sunscreen was of great quality. The only complaint I have is the scent. I wished the smell was more kid friendly and not chemically. The sunscreen still did it's job.

Love this sunscreen! Love the consistency and how easy to apply it is! It doesn't feel greasy at all and absorbs into the skin quickly! Worked perfectly for our little guy while he was outside for Easter egg hunts!

I love this brand, there's not a product that I've tried that I've not liked. I already owned this sunscreen and when I saw I was getting another I was stoked especially when summer is right around the corner! My whole family uses it. My kids love that it doesn't leave a white cast on them. It's super light, and isn't sticky. I literally put this on my face every day before I step foot outside. Really does the job and helps with preventing sun burn when used as directed!!
This is the best for kids, my son have sensitive skin and this product. It does not irritate the skin, it protects it from the sun. and we love it! It's great!

Sunscreen is important all year long. But, we tend to focus on the spring and summer days. Which is understandable because we are outside much more. I love that there is no strong scent. Making it easy to use as a year round sunscreen. It spreads extremely well! It has withstood hour and a half soccer practices and games in my son.

I really liked this sunscreen. I was hesitant at first because we only use mineral sunscreen but this sunscreen doesn't have the chemical order most have. It kept my daughter well protected at the water park and I would definitely purchase this product.

avis.titre: Love a good sunscreen for my kids!
avis.texte: My kids have a darker complexion so they don't burn east, but I still like to make sure they are wearing a good sunscreen so their skin is protected. This sunscreen was great and worked well for them!

There are some brands where you buy their products over and over again because they are just that good. La Roche Posay is that brand for me. I use their full line of skincare for myself and I was so excited to learn they make sunscreen for my kids too! This sunscreen rubs in easily and leaves no white cast. I love the fact that it is water resistant for 80 minutes and doesn't cause a reaction on my kids sensitive skin. Overall a great product that I will reach for again and again.

avis.titre: A gentle sunscreen for fun in the sun
avis.texte: Had to wait to use this as texas weather has been all over the place. What a fun summer by the pool smell, it goes on easily and lasts! No oily residue. A little goes a long way on little faces. My 7 year old had no issues with this sunscreen sweating off into her eyes. We were very pleased!

I love that my kids are able to use it. Both have sensitive skin but they didn't have no reaction to the sunscreen. The smell was not to powerful like the regular sunscreen. I love how it feels, it doesn't go on greasy and it's now watery and not to thick it the perfect consistency.

I like that this suncreen doesnt smell first of all. Secondly, it is gentile on sensitive skin and is moisturizing. It also does not leave a white cast like some sunscreens. I feel comfortable and confident in using this sunscreen on my children.
I havent actuwlly used it as full on suncreen yet bc thecwesther hasnt been appropriate but my kids have extremely sensitive skin and i have tested it on all 3 and therechas been.zero reaction
I loved this sunscreen fory kids! Goes on and doesnt feel so thick! They love playing outside for allmaot 4 hours and i always put this on them! Such a great product to protect kids skin!

I was pretty hesitant to use this on my kids. They both have very sensitive skin and have broken out before when we don't use neutrogena and sun bum sun screen. But this stuff is gentle and good on their skin! So excited we found one more product that is safe for my kids!

I tried this product on myself rather than my kids. I don't love the ingredients for them and there hasn't been an opportunity for them to apply it. The texture is great and doesn't leave any residue or white cast. It doesn't have a super strong smell and it absorbs well. Overall, if the ingredients don't bother you it seems like a good option.

avis.titre: My favorite skincare brand for myself & now my kid
avis.texte: I LOVE La roche-posay. I tell everyone that they are such an underrated brand because all of their products are amazing & this one is no different. I had no idea that they made kids sunscreen but now I'll never use anything else. It blends/rubs in beautifully and my kids are well protected from the sun. It also doesn't irritate my daughters sensitive skin. 10/10!!

I love that it's water resistant for 80 mins, as well as fragrance free. I have very sensitive skin and it didn't burn like some of the others I have tried. I'll definitely be buying another bottle when I run out.

This sunscreen is an absolute must have! This sunscreen provides broad spectrum SPF 50 protection and is for face and body. It is water resistant for up to 80 minutes. It's also non-whitening and lightweight. It's also formulated with Cellox-B3 Shield Technology and gives advanced UVA/UVB protection plus antioxidants. I will definitely continue to have this packed in our bag this season.
Works really well! Super moisturizing, spreads easy, and keeps my kiddos from getting burnt while at the beach or out playing in that Florida sun! I love la roche-posay products!

avis.titre: A nice gentle and safe formula
avis.texte: Brought this to vacation in Florida and used it the first time here. I love how it feels and goes on my kids skin. This will be replacing the normal spray on one we use!

Let me start by saying that I have kids with red hair and super fair skin. They can be in partial sun and still end up with a horrible sunburn. I was excited to try a new product just for kids. I liked the scent and consistency gaub.of the sunscreen. My youngest generally gets the most burnt and I definitely noticed less of a burn the days I used this lotion compared to our normal brand
This worked great for the kids. No overpowering scent. The scent is very mild. It goes on nice and smooth and covers evenly without leaving any notivable residue. Great product with great protection

This is a very nice children's sunscreen. It's lightweight and leaves no noticeable white-cast. I tested it on my child's olive skin, and my medium skin and didn't notice any whiteness. For darker skin tones this may not be true, but it was true for us. My child has a skin condition that causes itchy bumps and dryness. I noticed her skin looked pretty moisturized after using this and she didn't complain of any burning or discomfort. It isn't greasy, and it's very easy to rub in. It does have a pretty strong sunscreen smell, but I think that's to be expected with body SPF. I'm looking forward to using this often during the summer months!
The only sun screen I feel good about using on my kiddos sensitive skin. This sunscreen gets a phenomenal score on EWG which leaves me assured it as quality, non toxic ingredients!

We live right next to the ocean and as the weather starts to heat up we get a lot more sun. This sunscreen was perfect for my kids! It applied easy, stayed through water, and kept them from getting too much sun. I will be purchasing this again!

I got this in March in NY… so I haven't been able to use it to test it in the actual sun. But I tried it and it blends nicely, not too thick and hard to rub in. There's no scent which is nice as well.

avis.titre: No more waiting to get into the pool
avis.texte: Does appear white at first but absorbs into the skin and just like lotion. This leaves no white cast and absorbs very fast it looks like there is no sunscreen on. It is sticky for a few minutes then it becomes smooths to the skin due to the cell-ox shield in the product. This means no more waiting to get into the pool. My kids loved it also it is water resistant for 80 minutes. I also love how gentle this is made for sensitive skin my daughter with eczema this is the best.
